v22: General_Type controlled vocabulary reconciled and framework-currency corrections. (1) The Data Dictionary entry for General_Type began with a literal ellipsis and declared only six Public Bodies terms while thirteen were in use, leaving 21 of 44 records non-conforming behind a passing gate. The vocabulary is now closed at twelve terms: Ministerial Department, Non-Ministerial Department, Executive Agency, Executive NDPB, Advisory NDPB, Independent Regulator, Statutory corporation, Devolved Administration, Devolved Public Body, Government Unit / Authority, Local Government (collective), Non-governmental body / Partnership. Retired: "Independent Statutory Body" (a four-way catch-all), "Executive Agency / Trading Fund" (compound), "NGO Partnership / Coalition" (renamed). (2) Reclassified ORG-007 OEP to Executive NDPB; ORG-040 FCA to Independent Regulator; ORG-024 The Crown Estate and ORG-031 NI Climate Commissioner to Statutory corporation; ORG-017 Met Office to Executive Agency with the trading-fund status moved to Remit_And_Powers; ORG-042 State of Nature Partnership to Non-governmental body / Partnership. (3) Legislation vocabulary gains "Retained EU Law", in use on LEG-047 and previously undeclared. Policies & Activities needed no change. (4) ORG-031 corrected: the office was established by The Executive Office under SR 2025 No. 78, in operation 9 April 2025, and is a corporation sole under reg. 5; Link repointed from the 2022 Act to the regulations. Lead_Department still reads [ORG-036] DAERA, which is wrong at department level but retained pending a decision on how NI departments are represented - flagged, not silently changed. (5) POL-004 marked superseded by the Carbon Budget and Growth Delivery Plan (October 2025); POL-017 annotated with CCRA4-IA (20 May 2026) while remaining the current statutory CCRA. Records for the CBGDP, CCRA4-IA, SR 2025 No. 78 and The Executive Office are queued in Data/pending_additions.md, not written here. (6) Data Dictionary: the Legislation Status vocabulary was too narrow for the values in use (12 breaches, e.g. "In force (phased commencement)", "Adjourned 2nd reading") and is redeclared with free-text qualifiers - In force [qualifier] | Royal Assent [date] | Before Parliament | Adjourned [stage] | Pending - which the new checker matches on the stem. No record values changed.

v23: ORG-036 repurposed from the Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs to the NORTHERN IRELAND EXECUTIVE, so that all four UK administrations are held at the same tier - [ORG-034] Scottish Government, [ORG-035] Welsh Government, [ORG-036] Northern Ireland Executive - and no devolved department is held as a record. The ID was repurposed rather than retired so that the fourteen inbound references stay intact; ORG-036 has always denoted "the Northern Ireland administration" in those references, and only its name was at the wrong tier. Sourced from northernireland.gov.uk: the Executive Committee is the First Minister, deputy First Minister and eight departmental Ministers, across nine departments, with the Programme for Government 2024-2027 agreed 27 February 2025. Department names now appear in prose as "Northern Ireland Executive (DAERA)" or "(The Executive Office)": updated on ORG-004 JNCC, ORG-016 NIEA (also in Remit_And_Powers), ORG-031 NI Climate Commissioner, LEG-038, LEG-039, LEG-040, LEG-059, POL-028, POL-052, POL-067, POL-069 and the Cross-Reference Index. This RESOLVES the v22 flag on ORG-031: its sponsor is The Executive Office, not DAERA, and [ORG-036] now resolves correctly at administration level. The scope rule is recorded in the ORG-036 Remit_And_Powers text so a later scan does not re-raise it.

v24: ORG-014 Name corrected from "Scottish Natural Heritage" to "NatureScot", the body’s operating name, which every other record in the three workbooks already used - the Acronym field, POL-066, IFW-03, five international UK_Links entries and six indicator Data_Source values. Scottish Natural Heritage remains the name in the legislation that established and empowers the body, and that is now stated in Remit_And_Powers rather than sitting in the Name field. Cross-Reference Index updated to match.

v25: Policy_Sector reconciled, and the Cross-Reference Index put under automatic regeneration. The 14-class shared vocabulary was adopted in indicators workbook v11 (see EXPORT_SCOPING_NOTE section 2.4) and every record sheet in all three workbooks already conformed - a re-check found ZERO non-canonical tokens in any record sheet. The fork was confined to the Cross-Reference Index, a derived sheet that was never regenerated after that migration and is read by nothing, so the drift was invisible until the controlled-vocabulary invariant added in the previous version went looking. This workbook's Data Dictionary now declares the 14 classes in place of the pre-migration slash-style list. The index has been regenerated from its source sheets by the new Data/code/rebuild_xref.py, which finalise.py now runs as step 1 of 4, before the integrity check; hand-editing the index is no longer meaningful and the Data Dictionary says so. The VOCAB_WARN_ONLY debt entry for Policy_Sector has been removed from check_links.py, so Policy_Sector is now a hard gate condition rather than a warning. Details of the rebuild are in the run output and in Data/pending_additions.md.

v26: Two approved queue candidates written as Policies & Activities records. POL-070 National assessment of flood and coastal erosion risk in England (NaFRA2), Environment Agency, published 17 December 2024 and last updated 5 August 2026 - the national risk assessment that [IND-E-042] already names as a data source but which had no record of its own; reciprocal Related_Policy_Links added on [POL-045]. POL-071 Monitoring the condition of the natural environment, the statutory statement under Environment Act 2021 s.16 setting out what data Defra will obtain to monitor whether the natural environment is improving, covering the 13 Environment Act targets - it is the monitoring architecture behind [IFW-01]. DATE CORRECTION: the queue recorded POL-071 as a July 2026 publication; 16 July 2026 is the latest update to a statement first published 23 May 2022, and the record says so. The third approved candidate, the FCERM central government funding and performance statistic, was decided as NO ACTION by Jonathan on 18 September.
